disclaimer: Permission support below is transcribed from Microsoft Learn pages reviewed on the review date. Re-check the permissions reference before production consent. Granting these permissions does not by itself establish regulatory compliance.
notes: The /me Graph routes require a signed-in user and therefore delegated permissions. Application permissions are not supported on /me.
Personal Microsoft accounts are not supported for these permissions.

Agent365.Observability.OtelWrite is the delegated permission for the Agent 365 OpenTelemetry exporter. A registered agent instance can use the service-to-service exporter route without that delegated permission.
CopilotPackages.Read.All requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license and, in the reviewed cloud matrix, is listed for the global service.

permissions.name: CopilotPackages.Read.All
permissions.purpose: Read the Agent 365 / Copilot package catalog for inventory.

permissions.name: ProtectionScopes.Compute.User
permissions.purpose: Compute Purview protection scopes for a user.

permissions.name: Content.Process.User
permissions.purpose: Evaluate prompt and response text with processContent.

permissions.name: ContentActivity.Write
permissions.purpose: Record a content activity audit event.

permissions.name: Agent365.Observability.OtelWrite
permissions.purpose: Send OpenTelemetry to Agent 365 on the delegated exporter route.

application.alternative: Registered agent instances use the S2S exporter route without this delegated permission.
